text: Could you make me a little music bed? I’ve been wanting something like this for a while, but I always end up overthinking how to describe it. What I mean is lo-fi hip-hop, and it should be 10 seconds long. I want it to feel warm and relaxed. Please keep it instrumental, with no vocals.
